name: ops-brain MCP
description: Self-hosted team bus for AI agents: cross-machine handoffs, check-in, and shared knowledge on your own PostgreSQL. Reads keep Guard's usual handling; writes to the shared bus and both deletes are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start with check_in, search_bus, get_handoff and list_handoffs; they only read the bus.
Over stdio there is no authentication: ops-brain runs with full access to the configured database. Per-agent tokens and exclude_client_data apply only to a separately configured HTTP deployment.
delete_handoff and delete_knowledge are hard deletes (handoff deletes leave an audit_log row); prefer complete_handoff.
This entry matches the stdio binary only. Shared HTTP deployments are self-hosted with no official endpoint; set them up on Guard's Protect page.
